eventName: Inauguration of the 50000 tree sapling plantation project
eventDescription:
Kanchipuram Municipal Corporation, in association with Vidhaigal Organization and Kanchi Annachathiram, has launched a major initiative to plant 50,000 tree saplings across areas under the jurisdiction of Kanchipuram Municipal Corporation.
The inauguration ceremony was held today at Anna Park, Pillaiyarpalayam, Kanchipuram.
Students and participants from various institutions actively took part in the event, including:
? Narayana Guru School
? St. Mary's College of Allied Health Sciences
? Kanchi Sports Academy
? Adhiparasakthi Agricultural College
? Nature enthusiasts and environmental volunteers
